concepts.gloss_en: The union of the tzaddik and the Congregation of Israel (the tzaddik channels divine influx to Knesset Yisrael)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are in LM 54 and refer to the same idea — the tzaddik bestowing/uniting with Knesset Yisrael, explicitly equated with 'noteh shamayim kayri'ah' and masa u'matan. The only difference between the two forms is the particle 'של' (bare construct vs. periphrastic genitive), which is the same phrase, not a homograph or distinct concept.
